## Problem and change

Describe the visitor or developer problem and the resulting behaviour. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. For visual changes, include desktop/mobile screenshots using fictional data. Note checks not run and any help needed from the maintainer.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and the relevant project instructions.
- [ ] This PR contains no private submissions, correspondence, credentials or personal-data test fixtures.
- [ ] Changed interactions have appropriate regression coverage; existing checks have not been weakened.
- [ ] Factual/content changes cite their sources, and changelog/design notes are updated where applicable (or not applicable).

Public-content corrections involving personal information should use the private correction route, not this PR.
